verdict.rationale: Quo's own marketing names all three parts of the story for its AI agent Sona: it answers when the team can't, captures the details needed, and hands the conversation to the team. The evidence is a single vendor marketing line with no in-depth docs on how Sona works. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of Sona's call answering, message capture and handoff/escalation mechanics (e.g. how it transfers live vs. after the fact), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, an AI agent can answer the line, take a message, and hand off to a human

citations.quote: Sona answers when your team can't, captures the details you need, and hands the conversation to your team when it matters.
